title: A FAST brief tells the user 'No web-search backend configured — structured data only' when the keyless backend is configured and every engine is only cooling down (breaker-skipped engines leave the typed reason 'unreachable')
repro: Two research turns back to back on one sidecar (second during the first's searches): second FAST brief publishes note 'No web-search backend configured — structured data only', web_reason 'unreachable' while GET /search/status shows t1_keyless with ddg/brave/mojeek 'cooling down'. Deterministic: open all three keyless breakers -> KeylessSearchBackend.search raises SearchError reason=unreachable with message 'cooling down (45s)... Wait a moment and retry'.
